en.html: ...The dragoon took the blow from the back of my blade without the slightest concern, and completed the stroke that killed my foster mother.

ja.html:
……俺の、峰打ちを受けた竜騎兵は、
　意にも介さず、養母を殺す一撃を完遂した。
